_comment: Data-driven game-over / fail screen (docs/HudSystem.md §11a). Loaded by UI::loadGameScreenInto(ui,"game_over",...) into game_over:<panel> screens. Shown by GameScreen::showGameOver() — the shipped shell enters it when the player dies (unless game.json lose.auto_game_over is false) or on a `show_game_over` trigger action. {{title}} resolves via MenuActions.onResolveVariable. Buttons: main_menu / quit_game. (Ravenmere gap G-38.)

children.text: {{title}} ends here. The last save point is where the road resumes.
